name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport logistics began unexpectedly. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, he initially worked in the automotive manufacturing sector. However, a chance encounter with a local racing team needing logistical support sparked a career shift. He quickly proved adept at managing the complex movement of equipment and personnel, developing a reputation for meticulous planning and problem-solving under pressure.

Over the past two decades, Ahmad has worked with several high-profile teams across various racing disciplines, from Formula racing to GT endurance events. His approach is rooted in anticipating potential challenges and developing robust contingency plans. He firmly believes that success in motorsport hinges not only on speed and technology, but also on the seamless execution of logistical operations. Ahmad's distinctive ability lies in bridging the gap between technical requirements and practical implementation, ensuring that the team's resources are always in the right place at the right time.

Known for his calm demeanor and unwavering focus, Ahmad has earned the respect of his colleagues and competitors alike. He prides himself on building strong relationships with suppliers and partners, fostering a collaborative environment that promotes efficiency and innovation. His dedication to precision and his passion for motorsport make him an invaluable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a slightly stocky build, and always looks sharp and professional.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously detailed schedules and checklists.
Insists on arriving at the track at least two hours before any other team member.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
